name: compound-writing
description: A context-first writing toolbox for project setup, idea development, drafting, revision, stress-testing, and publication preparation that preserves voice, judgment, and source provenance.

interface.shortDescription: A full writing toolbox with a context-aware front door
interface.longDescription: Compound Writing provides a full toolbox for setting up a portable writing project, developing ideas, drafting, revising, pressure-testing, and preparing work for publication. Scribe acts as the context-aware front door, choosing the smallest useful workflow while every specialist tool remains available for direct use. The system preserves source provenance, writer voice, and human ownership of consequential decisions.
defaultPrompt: Set up a new self-contained writing project.
Help me develop this idea into a strong piece.
Help me choose the right tool for this draft.
